description:
PDACAnnotation is a medical imaging application designed to support the 
review, annotation, and classification of pancreatic lesions on CT. It 
provides automatic pancreas segmentation that can be manually 
adjusted by the user, as well as dedicated segmentation tools for 
lesion annotation. The application enables users to classify individual 
lesions through structured forms and to perform an overall 
assessment of the pancreatic condition using standardized 
classification workflows. The tool is intended to assist clinicians and 
researchers in the consistent analysis and annotation of pancreatic 
imaging data
name: AIDREAMPancreas
